Prismatic Pride Commander Sealed – Presented by Wizards Pride - $90 (Click here for more info)

Join the Wizards Pride team for a special Commander Sealed event: Prismatic Pride! Presented in partnership with our Pride ERG, we're celebrating our LGBTQ+ characters and players through the universal language of Magic.

Build a sealed Commander deck from six Mystery Booster Commander Edition boosters, any number of basic lands, and the contents of your "Pride Playtest Packet" (more on that later), and play some friendly games of Magic! To help smooth out the deck building process and bring the prismatic spirit, you'll treat every eligible commander as though they had partner, similar to the rules of Magic Presents: Pride.

The 59 new cards in Mystery Booster Commander Edition, plus one card that was previously only available on digital platforms and doesn’t have the acorn symbol on it, (MBC collector numbers 1–60) are legal in Commander, Legacy, and Vintage. They are not legal in the Standard, Pioneer, or Modern formats.
Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.
For complete registration instructions, please visit - https://mcatlanta.mtgfestivals.com/en-us/badges/how-to-buy.html#purchase-ticketed-play
After purchasing your event entry, update your event information to include your Wizards Account email address.
Companion App code found at the bottom of your confirmation email.
Enter the code before the start of your event.
If this is a team event, only one teammate should enter the Companion App code.
You do not need to check in!
Sealed Tournament: No supplies/card needed. Basic lands will be provided.
Product: 6x Mystery Booster Commander Edition Boosters, 1x Pride Playtest Packet: contains 4 of 20 unknown-style playtest cards
Each player will receive a Pride Playtest Packet featuring four Unknown-style playtest cards.
Each of these cards depicts an LGBTQ+ Magic character that can be your commander.
While these cards aren't legal in any formats, you can use them here—and use them proudly!
Studio X's Arya Karamchandani led the design of these cards and will be on-site at this event to celebrate our community and share stories about how we brought this event to life.
Estimated length of deck build and play: 4 - 5 hours
Format details can be found at https://www.pastimesevents.com/formats.
Participation: 1,500 Prize Tix and a Foil Promo Gilded Lotus.

Those cards start the game in exile. The player may cast one of those cards during the game as though it were in their hand; when they do, they may shuffle the other into their library. Players begin each game with only a single Echoed Pair in exile.
Two copies of the same legendary card do not qualify as an Echoed Pair. The pair must consist of the two different cards that are part of a specific Echoed Pair from the bonus sheet.

A player may draft multiple pairs over the course of the draft (including by picking up unpaired legendaries whose Echoed Pair partners come up in later packs). If a player ends up with more than one complete Echoed Pair, they designate one Echoed Pair as their exiled pair before a game begins.

Join us for a Commander Sealed Grand Melee. You will receive 12 boosters to create your deck, battle in the melee, and win prizes.

The 59 new cards in Mystery Booster Commander Edition, plus one card that was previously only available on digital platforms and doesn’t have the acorn symbol on it, (MBC collector numbers 1–60) are legal in Commander, Legacy, and Vintage. They are not legal in the Standard, Pioneer, or Modern formats.

If an infinite combo is demonstrated that player will receive 4,000 Prize Tix, be congratulated for winning, and be dropped from the event. All other players will continue to play.
The Commander banned and restricted list will be used. Playtest cards from Mystery Boosters may be used as an exception.
Decks must contain exactly 60 cards, including the commander.
Except for basic lands, no two cards in the deck may have the same English name. Some cards (e.g., Relentless Rats) may have rules text that overrides this restriction.

Join a pod of four and draft it out in this specialty Echoverse Pick-Two Draft.
Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.

Draft Tournament: No supplies/cards needed to participate. Basic lands will be provided.
Rounds: Two (2) Swiss rounds. 50 minutes per round.Estimated length of deck build and play: 3 to 4 hours

Players will be encouraged to draft at least one Echoverse pair from their packs to play with their decks.Before each game begins, a player may reveal two different cards they drafted that are part of an Echoed Pair. Those cards start the game in exile. The player may cast one of those cards during the game as though it were in their hand; when they do, they may shuffle the other into their library. Players begin each game with only a single Echoed Pair in exile.
Two copies of the same legendary card do not qualify as an Echoed Pair. The pair must consist of the two different cards that are part of a specific Echoed Pair from the bonus sheet.

A player may draft multiple pairs over the course of the draft (including by picking up unpaired legendaries whose Echoed Pair partners come up in later packs). If a player ends up with more than one complete Echoed Pair, they designate one Echoed Pair as their exiled pair before a game begins.

Magic Presents: Reality Echoes - Pick Two Special Draft - Reality Fracture - $30 (Click here for more info)
Join a pod of four and draft it out in this specialty Echoverse Pick-Two Draft.
Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.
For complete registration instructions, please visit - https://mcatlanta.mtgfestivals.com/en-us/badges/how-to-buy.html#purchase-ticketed-play

Draft Tournament: No supplies/cards needed to participate. Basic lands will be provided.
Rounds: Two (2) Swiss rounds. 50 minutes per round.Estimated length of deck build and play: 3 to 4 hours

Players will be encouraged to draft at least one Echoverse pair from their packs to play with their decks.Before each game begins, a player may reveal two different cards they drafted that are part of an Echoed Pair. Those cards start the game in exile. The player may cast one of those cards during the game as though it were in their hand; when they do, they may shuffle the other into their library. Players begin each game with only a single Echoed Pair in exile.
Two copies of the same legendary card do not qualify as an Echoed Pair. The pair must consist of the two different cards that are part of a specific Echoed Pair from the bonus sheet.

A player may draft multiple pairs over the course of the draft (including by picking up unpaired legendaries whose Echoed Pair partners come up in later packs). If a player ends up with more than one complete Echoed Pair, they designate one Echoed Pair as their exiled pair before a game begins.

Commander and Cocktails League with Brian David-Marshall - $200 (Click here for more info)

Join Brian David-Marshall as he discusses brewing commander decks while you brew a new Commander deck for the weekend’s sealed Commander and Cocktails League. You will receive 24 assorted boosters to create your deck, a league card to play games and win prizes, a tiki mug, and receive a unique recipe card featuring a specially crafted cocktail for this event.
This event is your time to hang out with BDM, build decks if you have not already, and play league games. The league portion of this event is an all-weekend league.

The 59 new cards in Mystery Booster Commander Edition, plus one card that was previously only available on digital platforms and doesn’t have the acorn symbol on it, (MBC collector numbers 1–60) are legal in Commander, Legacy, and Vintage. They are not legal in the Standard, Pioneer, or Modern formats.
Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.
For complete registration instructions, please visit - https://mcatlanta.mtgfestivals.com/en-us/badges/how-to-buy.html#purchase-ticketed-play

Starting on Friday at the league check-in desk, you can start picking up your boosters to create your deck with, a league card to track games, win prizes, and get a unique recipe card featuring a specially crafted cocktail for this event.
The Saturday, 8:00 pm, event is your time to hang out and play with Brian David-Marshall as well as each other, receive your cocktail voucher*, and build decks if you have not.
This league is an all-weekend league. During the hours below we will assist with matchmaking and give out prizes.
Commander Sealed League: No supplies/cards needed to participate. Basic lands will be provided.

Product: 24x Play Boosters of the following sets: 4x Mystery Booster Commander Edition, 4x Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™, 4x Magic: The Gathering® | The Hobbit™, 3x Reality Fracture, 3x Secrets of Strixhaven, 3x Lorwyn Eclipsed, 3x Edge Of Eternitites
League Play: Six (6) matches tracked with a league card for continued play across the weekend.
The Commander banned and restricted list will be used. Playtest cards from Mystery Booster may be used as an exception.
Decks must contain exactly 100 cards, including the commander.
Except for basic lands, no two cards in the deck may have the same English name. Some cards (e.g., Relentless Rats) may have rules text that overrides this restriction.
Format details can be found at https://www.pastimesevents.com/formats
All players receive: 500 Prize Tix per Match (Max of 6 Matches)
*Mocktail or cocktail - You must be 21 years of age or older to receive a cocktail. Any participant may use their drink voucher for a mocktail.
Contact Pastimes Events on their Discord server at https://www.pastimesevents.com/discord.

The 59 new cards in Mystery Booster Commander Edition, plus one card that was previously only available on digital platforms and doesn’t have the acorn symbol on it, (MBC collector numbers 1–60) are legal in Commander, Legacy, and Vintage. They are not legal in the Standard, Pioneer, or Modern formats.

Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.
For complete registration instructions, please visit - https://mcatlanta.mtgfestivals.com/en-us/badges/how-to-buy.html#purchase-ticketed-play

IMPORTANT ADDITIONAL DETAILS

Starting on Friday at the league check-in desk, you can start picking up your boosters to create your deck with, a league card to track games, win prizes, and get a unique recipe card featuring a specially crafted cocktail for this event.

The Saturday, 8:00 pm, event is your time to hang out and play with Brian David-Marshall as well as each other, receive your cocktail voucher*, and build decks if you have not.


This league is an all-weekend league. During the hours below we will assist with matchmaking and give out prizes.

Friday, November 13th: 10:00 am - 9:00 pm
Saturday, November 14th: 10:00 am - 9:00 pm
Sunday, November 15th: 10:00 am - 4:00 pm

LEAGUE DETAILS

Commander Sealed League: No supplies/cards needed to participate. Basic lands will be provided.
Product: 24x Play Boosters of the following sets: 4x Mystery Booster Commander Edition, 4x Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™, 4x Magic: The Gathering® | The Hobbit™, 3x Reality Fracture, 3x Secrets of Strixhaven, 3x Lorwyn Eclipsed, 3x Edge Of Eternitites
League Play: Six (6) matches tracked with a league card for continued play across the weekend.
Pods: 3 to 4 players

Additional Rules

The Commander banned and restricted list will be used. Playtest cards from Mystery Booster may be used as an exception.
Decks must contain exactly 100 cards, including the commander.
Except for basic lands, no two cards in the deck may have the same English name. Some cards (e.g., Relentless Rats) may have rules text that overrides this restriction.

Format details can be found at https://www.pastimesevents.com/formats

Prizes (per player)

All players receive: 500 Prize Tix per Match (Max of 6 Matches)

*Mocktail or cocktail - You must be 21 years of age or older to receive a cocktail. Any participant may use their drink voucher for a mocktail.

Starfleet Academy League - $55 (Click here for more info)

Starfleet Academy wants you! Admission is competitive, with many viable candidates on the field. We need applicants who excel in key areas: aptitude, game experience, and deck building. The trials may be rigorous including performance under pressure, and psychological scrutiny. Buckle down and you will pass the exams, rank up and become one of Starfleet's finest.
Only the badge holder can register for event entries. If you purchased a badge for someone else, you must register and purchase their event entries until the badge is transferred to them.
For complete registration instructions, please visit - https://mcatlanta.mtgfestivals.com/en-us/badges/how-to-buy.html#purchase-ticketed-play
After purchasing your event entry, update your event information to include your Wizards Account email address.
Companion App code found at the bottom of your confirmation email.
Enter the code before the start of your event.
If this is a team event, only one teammate should enter the Companion App code.
You do not need to check in!
Commander Sealed League: No supplies/cards needed to participate. Basic lands will be provided.
Product: 6x Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™ Play Boosters
League Play: 15 matches tracked with a league card for continued play across the weekend.
To complete your exams you will need to complete three (3) matches in each of the 5 locations. Four Space Quadrants and Starfleet. Good Luck Cadet.
Starting on Friday at the league check-in desk, you can start picking up your boosters to create your deck with, a league card to track games, win prizes.
The Saturday, 12:30 pm and the Sunday 11am events are your time to hang out and play with each other, receive your pool, and build decks if you have not.
Players may attend either or both meet-ups.
This league is an all-weekend league. During the hours below we will assist with matchmaking and give out prizes.
Participation: Foil promo to be announced.
Contact Pastimes Events on their Discord server at https://www.pastimesevents.com/discord.

All tournament add-ons are non-refundable and non-transferable and cannot be reproduced, resold or upgraded. Please carefully review the estimated tournament lengths for each tournament. This is it, the time to find out who has what it takes to sneaky snatch the trophy. The Top 4 players from each qualifier will face off in the Battlebox Finals
Qualified players will be added automatically
This event will be run using a paper bracket
Constructed Tournament: No supplies/cards needed to participate.

Players share an 80-card library as well as graveyard and exile zones.
Players start the game at 20 life.
At the beginning of the game, players alternate drawing cards until both players have seven cards.
If an opening hand does not contain two or more lands, that player may reveal their hand and take a free mulligan.
A player loses the game if they draw from an empty deck.
If an effect causes both players to draw a card, then the active player deals the cards in the same fashion as the opening hands, starting with the opponent.
If an effect returns a card from “your” graveyard/library, it refers now to the shared graveyard/library.
